selected_evidence.requirement: node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared with persistent active NFS service
selected_evidence.summary: The configured export is live; nfs-kernel-server is active and enabled after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 persistently mounts the export at /mnt/shared
selected_evidence.summary: The NFSv4 mount is active and its /etc/fstab entry persisted through restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: dataops has UID and GID 4500 on both systems
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes resolve dataops as UID 4500 with primary GID 4500 before and after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Shared directory is dataops:dataops with mode 2770 and supports consistent cross-node ownership
selected_evidence.summary: Both views report directory UID/GID 4500 and mode 2770; files created from either node resolve as dataops:dataops with consistent permissions.
Healthy baseline boot ID 4b7ded33… was captured, restart was acknowledged, temporary unavailability occurred, boot ID changed to 165842a6…, and the export plus client read/write access recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 0256e3f5… was captured, restart was acknowledged, temporary unavailability occurred, boot ID changed to 26a6b353…, the mount returned automatically, and fresh client data was verified on node1.
